messages.snippet: You are invited to our autumn corporate training session, 'Warranty & Indemnity Insurance: Market Up
messages.subject: Invitation: Autumn corporate training - W&I insurance update
messages.plaintextBody:
You are invited to our autumn corporate training session, 'Warranty & Indemnity Insurance: Market Update 2025', on Thursday 16 October at 12:30 in the 8th floor seminar room (lunch provided). External speakers from a leading W&I broker will cover current pricing, enhancement trends and claims experience. 1.5 hours CPD.

RSVP via the link in the calendar invite.

Knowledge & Learning Team
